## Nightly Agent Self-Check: the agents test themselves
On a schedule, this workflow sends one read-only chat turn to each of the 32 chat agents, checks that each one answered, and builds a pass/fail digest. When an agent fails, the execution fails, so it shows in red in the Executions list.

### How it works
- Schedule fires at 02:00 UTC (change it in the trigger or the time zone in Workflow settings).
- "Build probe list" holds one {name, url, prompt} per chat agent (the agents' internal webhooks). scripts/flows/n8n_fix.py regenerates it.
- "Ping agent" calls each webhook, one at a time, with the "Lab Agents Chat" credential and a fresh session per agent per run, so no conversation memory leaks between runs.
- "Score & digest" needs HTTP 2xx and a real answer, then builds `report_markdown`. Agents that are not published (HTTP 404, for example an agent whose prerequisites are missing) are skipped. "Any failures?" stops the execution with an error that names the failed agents.

### Opt-in
n8n-import publishes this workflow only when NIGHTLY_SELF_QA=1 is set in `.env`. Each run makes one model call per agent (more for agents that use tools), so leave it off on laptops.

### Send the digest somewhere
Add a Slack, Microsoft Teams, or email node after "Score & digest" and send `report_markdown`. To run it now, open the workflow and select **Execute workflow**.
